title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - SubProcessorDataTransfer
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/SubProcessorDataTransfer. Specifies data transfer to a sub-processor with associated management details. Subclass of DataTransfer per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataTransfer model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SubProcessorDataTransfer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

subProcessor.description: Relationship. Sub-processor to which the data can be transferred. Links to a LegalPerson entity.

subProcessorManagement.description: Relationship. Management means of the sub-processor. Links to a LegalDocument entity.
